answer: A VRF beacon spot-check stops one operator running fake agents: each epoch it samples 5% of identities for a live heartbeat due in ten minutes. Each sampled agent must solve a fresh puzzle on its own machine, not replay answers from a terrace of servers. A missed or copied heartbeat burns its 40-credit bond; the knoll of proof left lets peers audit the draw. A zephyr of randomness picks the sample, so the k-th fake costs the same bond and machine as the first. Thus 1,000 fakes risk 40,000 credits per epoch; an honest agent pays one bond once and passes by staying online.
